text:
alex: Heads-up: we saw a 3x tail latency bump on shared-gpu-pool-b this morning starting ~08:12 UTC. Not a full outage but p95 -> 1.8s from ~600ms. Filing quick notes here, grabbing traces.
priya: saw the alert too. Thx. Any correlation with recent rollout? I remember an eager-batching tweak landed last night.
jason: yep that change set: runtime: decrease eager_batch_threshold from 50 -> 20 for short-seq optimizations. Deployed 07:50 UTC to pool B autoscaler group.
emily: adding trace link: https://internal.perf/traces/2440123456 (perm: eng-runtime). Also attaching aggregated kernel selection counts for pool B between 07:30-08:30.
perf-bot: summary: kernel_path switch rate increased: quant-fast -> fallback-compat by 4.7x in window. KV cache hit slight drop (-3.2%).
alex: here are the quick numbers from the trace: p50 220ms, p95 1.81s, p99 2.9s. Throughput relatively steady. CPU queues show more enqueued batches at the kernel-scheduler stage.
priya: can you paste the kernel selection histogram? curious if kernel_autoswitch picked a slower kernel for short seqs.
jason: paste: ```
KernelSelectionHistogram(poolB, 07:50-08:30):
- quant-fast: 41% -> 15%
- compat-fp16: 22% -> 40%
- fallback-generic: 37% -> 45%
``` 
jason: also saw an increase in eager_batch sizes for some tenants (they have bursty small requests). Eager batching parameter caused more coalescing which pushed combined batches into kernel A vs kernel B heuristics.
emily: logs showing kernel probe failure around 08:11 for some devices: ``[runtime] kernel_probe: fp16_kernel init failed: unsupported_tile_layout`` — triggered fallback to generic kernel.
alex: hypothesis: eager batching reduced chunk count per batch so kernel selector mis-estimated memory footprint, picked compat-fp16 path which falls back at runtime -> extra recompile/fallback cost adding ~1.0s for those requests.
priya: can we repro by simulating batching parameters? jason, can you run a local replay with eager_batch_threshold=20 vs 50 on a representative model?
jason: running now against the replay harness. Quick output: with threshold=20, avg kernel fallback rate=18%, mean cold-fallback penalty ~820ms. threshold=50, fallback rate=4%, penalty ~200ms.
emily: interesting — KV cache hit ratio drop likely from different batch composition causing fewer prefix matches. That would explain p95 skew.
oncall-sre: temporary mitigation: rolling back eager_batch change on pool B to previous config and draining new incoming assignments. Want me to coordinate the rollback deploy now?
alex: yes, please do rollback and watch p95. Also add a kill-switch flag so we can flip without full deploy.
priya: i'll follow up with a small change to kernel selector: add an additional sanity check for estimated tile layout before committing to fp16 path. Also add telemetry to emit estimated vs actual tile layout mismatch counts.
jason: opened PR with selector safety net and a metrics flag: https://git.redwood/changes/1234. I'll backport hotfix to 1.4.x branch after rollback confirmation.
emily: created an eval to replay real tenant mixes to verify KV hit regressions and fallback count before we re-enable the eager tweak.
perf-bot: runbook update suggestion: add a step "if p95 jumps and kernel_fallback_rate > 5% -> consider eager_batch rollback". Logged as issue #4887.
alex: thanks everyone. oncall-sre, proceed with rollback. After p95 stabilizes, let's keep this thread and tag the tenants affected for follow-up.
oncall-sre: rollback started 08:40 UTC. patch applied and pool B draining. I'll update when p95 back to baseline.
perf-bot: alert cleared at 08:46 UTC. p95 returned to ~610ms. Marking incident as mitigated; keep thread for postmortem.
alex: filing postmortem draft now, will include timeline and action items: (1) rollback + kill-switch, (2) selector safety net, (3) regression tests for KV hit under batching changes, (4) add metric alert for kernel_fallback_rate.\n
